independence_note: 40 source-labeled test files; 39 unique inputs; one unique test input also occurs in training. Not 40 independent held-out samples.

metadata.serial_process_policy: One worker OR one geometry JVM at a time; each case uses a fresh cold worker process

outlier_investigation_rules.note: No fitted acceptance thresholds. Inspect full per-cell IoU, area, centroid and outline deltas.

preparation.pixel_conversion: Pillow decodes one unsigned 8/16-bit scalar TIFF plane; preserve numerical pixels (palette TIFFs retain scalar palette indices, as in the original NumPy conversion); cast exactly to big-endian float32 row-major GATI v1; no color, intensity, size, or axis transformation.
